title: ReactApp eval agent functions
description: Agent functions of the ReactApp use cases. They run on the agent: a renderer that has no implementation sends each call to the agent with callAgentFunction.

estimateTravelTime.description: Runs on the agent. Estimates the total travel time in minutes to visit the stops in the given order, walking or by public transport. Takes a second or two.

stops.description: The stops in visiting order. Each stop is an object with `id` and `name`.

querySales.description: Runs on the agent. Returns the sales orders of a region between two dates, as a list of objects with `id`, `customer`, `date` and `amount`, newest first, at most 500. Takes a second or two.

region.description: The sales region, for example `EMEA`, `AMER` or `APAC`.

from.description: First day of the range, as an ISO date (YYYY-MM-DD).

to.description: Last day of the range, as an ISO date (YYYY-MM-DD).
